related_resources.reason: Krylov iteration, preconditioning and stopping criteria.

authorship.scope: New original instructional manuscript for the structured-solvers and numerical-spectral bridge; inherited narration unchanged.

prerequisites.reason: Positive definite energy, direct Cholesky solve, sparse fill.
Residuals, forward error, backward error and conditioning.

recommended.reason: Independent overview of Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel and CG.
Orthogonalization ideas that motivate conjugate directions.

background: Quadratic functions and derivatives, matrix-vector products, dot products and positive-definite matrices.
readiness_checks: Can you explain why a positive-definite quadratic has a unique minimizer?

description: Derives conjugate gradients as minimization of a quadratic energy and explains why conjugate search directions accelerate positive-definite solves.
